problem_type: Director animation retargeting applies source bind pose as target motion
symptom: Restored actions render as a T pose or horizontal body, and UAL idle/sit clips render with horizontal zombie arms; the prior conversion cannot be reproduced.
direct_cause: The conversion copied source local rotations onto x-bot bones while their bind-pose local bases and existing target action differed; the target armature action was also left active during manual pose assignment.
class_root: Every mapped semantic bone is converted by aiming target pose joints at the source playback world-space directions in each character's current hip/root frame; the metric checker independently compares those playback joints and never reuses rest-local conversion deltas.
affected_population: The four historical Mixamo actions restored from d3f68057c^
All Quaternius UAL actions retargeted to x-bot
Any future source skeleton with a different bind pose or an existing target action
entry_points: Offline conversion from the registered UAL archive
Offline conversion from the historical git GLB
Catalog and devlab readers of converted clips
internal_only_reason: The invariant is an application-owned source/target skeleton contract; no third-party runtime decides whether a converted clip is safe to catalog.
invariants: The metric uses only pose-evaluated world child-joint directions normalized by each frame's hip/root frame; rest-local matrices and conversion deltas are not measurement inputs.
The target armature has no pre-existing action while conversion writes pose matrices, and exported files are measured on the armature that owns the exported action.
A clip is catalog-eligible only when its sampled median angle error is below 10 degrees and p95 is below 20 degrees, with the T-pose, contact, and standing-hip checks passing.
The conversion command is deterministic for the same registered input hashes and emits a manifest with output hashes.

door_reduction.why_not: The catalog module is the planner-facing owner and the devlab is an independent visual reader; both must remain so the planner projection and the human inspection surface cannot silently share a stale render path.

generality_proof: Both registered source families converge on the same Blender retarget matrix routine and the same JSON metric checker. Catalog and devlab readers consume only clips whose manifest records a passing result, so another action, source skeleton, or future rerun cannot bypass the invariant.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Clear target animation, aim target pose joints in world space at source playback directions, and key the owning target armature.
Aggregate sampled bone-angle, T-pose, foot-contact, and standing-hip metrics and fail closed for any threshold violation.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Both the UAL archive and historical GLB conversion paths call the same routine with a source-name map.
Only clips recorded as passing by the metric manifest remain eligible for catalog entries.

recurrence.reason: Any action from another source rig, a changed x-bot asset, or a rerun of the old direct-copy script can reproduce the bind-pose mismatch.
same_class_scan: rg retarget|SkeletonUtils|COPY_ROTATION across scripts, src, and docs
Blender inspection of the UAL Rig, historical Armature, and x-bot Armature rest matrices

prevention.invariant: Every catalog candidate must carry >=12 sampled semantic-bone comparisons and pass all angle, T-pose, contact, and standing-hip thresholds.
prevention.failure_mode: The checker exits non-zero and the conversion manifest marks the action rejected; rejected actions are omitted from the catalog.
prevention.strategy: Keep conversion and measurement offline and deterministic, then make the catalog build consume only the checked manifest rather than rendered-state claims.

legacy_paths.rationale: The previous conversion scripts only existed in /tmp and were never repository paths; the checked-in converter is the first repository-owned path.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Blender is retained as the offline conversion tool because it imports the registered FBX/GLB sources and exports the existing FBX/GLB formats. The application runtime does not depend on Blender.
dependency_lifecycle.target: A pinned Blender release or a repository-owned glTF retargeter once it can reproduce the same matrix and export hashes.
exit_criteria: A replacement converter passes the same fixture and 12-sample metrics for both source families.
Two runs of the replacement emit byte-identical output hashes on CI and the macOS conversion host.

migration: Existing wrong canonical clips are regenerated from the registered historical GLB and UAL archive; the runtime cutover remains deferred and no stored user scene schema changes.
residual_risks: Blender's FBX exporter may carry format metadata that must be checked for byte stability; the manifest records the observed hashes.
The source license status of the historical Mixamo/three.js asset remains pending user judgment and is not changed by retargeting.

invariant_owner_layer.why: The metric checker is the single acceptance boundary; source-specific conversion code only produces candidates and cannot bypass the thresholds.
